fusions.name: Sounding Growl
fusions.desc: A growl pitched to echo strikes the first enemy in its path for 7 damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

fusions.name: Dusk Feeding
fusions.desc: Drops up to 5 tiles onto the target and bites for 14 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Torpor's End
fusions.desc: Shakes off your torpor: you restore 10 health at once and 5 stamina a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Moonless Prowl
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 10% more damage.
